html.body: Date: 2025-03-03 REMARKSIn the Final Office Action,' the Examiner took the following actions:1. rejected claim(s) 1, 8, and 14 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over HONG KWANG SEOK (KR 20200061016 A, "HONG"), in view of IMOSE KAZUO (WO 2004089212 Al, "IMOSE") in view of UMEMATSU, Terumi (WO 2018179150 Al, "UMEMATSU"), and further in view of D'MELLO YANNICK (CA 3181091, "D'MELLO"); and 2. objected to claims 2-7, 9-13, and 15-20 as being dependent upon a rejected base claim, but would be allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.By this Amendment, Applicant has amended claims 1, 3-4, 8, 10-11, 14, and 16-17, and canceled claims 2, 9 and 15 without prejudice to and disclaimer of the subject matter recited therein. The amendments are fully supported by the original disclosure. See, e.g., the original claims 2, 9 and 15. Upon entry of this Amendment, claims 1, 3-8, 10-14, and 16-20 are pending and under examination.Applicant respectfully requests reconsideration and withdrawal of the rejections, and the timely allowance of the pending claims for at least the reasons set forth below.Rejections of Claims under 35 U.S.C. § 103 Applicant respectfully traverses the rejection of claims 1, 8, and 14 under 35 U.S.C. 103 as being unpatentable over HONG, in view of IMOSE, in view of UMEMATSU, and further in view of D'MELLO.1 The Final Office Action may contain a number of statements reflecting characterization of the related art and the claims. Regardless of whether any such statement is identified herein, Applicant declines to automatically subscribe to any statement or characterization in the Final Office Action.Applicant respectfully submits that independent claim 1 has been amended to incorporate the allowable claim 2 identified by the Examiner; Independent claim 8 has been amended to incorporate the allowable claim 9 identified by the Examiner; and independent claim 14 has been amended to incorporate the allowable claim 15 identified by the Examiner. Therefore, claims 1, 8 and 14, as amended, are allowable.Accordingly, Applicant respectfully requests withdrawal of the rejections of claims 1, 8, and 14 under 35 U.S.C. 103.Allowable Subject Matter Applicant acknowledges with appreciation the identification of claims 2-7, 9-13, and 15- 20 as allowable if rewritten in independent form including all of the limitations of the base claim and any intervening claims.Applicant submits that claim 2 has been incorporated into the claim 1; claim 9 has been incorporated into the claim 8; and claim 15 has been incorporated into the claim 14.CONCLUSIONIn view of the foregoing amendments and remarks, Applicant respectfully requests Examiner's favorable consideration and timely allowance of all pending claims. If any issues may be resolved by telephone with the Applicant's representative, the Examiner is invited to contact the undersigned at the number shown below.Please grant any extensions of time required to enter this response and charge any additional required fees associated with filing of this response to Deposit Account No. 505213.Respectfully submitted, Anova Law Group, PLLC Dated:03/03/2025 By: /Xiaoqun Wu/ Xiaoqun Wu Reg. No. 54,553 (703) 430-5759
